test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

Ramu said, "Lots of people in my village helped the migrant workers by giving them food."

options.text: Ramu said that lots of people in his village helped the migrant workers by giving them food.
Ramu said that lots of people in my village helped the migrant workers by giving them food.
Ramu said that lots of people in my village are helping the migrant workers by giving them food.
Ramu said that lots of people in his village had helped the migrant workers by giving them food.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Ramu said that lots of people in his village had helped the migrant workers by giving them food.**
